LIST OF THE COUNCIL OF MINISTER SWORN IN
AT 10.45 A.M. ON MONDAY, 14 JANUARY, 1980,
IN THE RASHTRAPATI BHAVAN.

blocks.html:

15.Shri Pranab MukherjeeMinister of Commerce.
